red_identity.sidecar_provenance: Copied unchanged from the previous collision fixture green.controlled_build.json; root reported the RED executable had this exact SHA-256. Runtime banner retains the pre-commit 60d14b9c6 build revision.

neighbors.qualification: CPU/headless neighbor regression only; not actual GPU qualification.

static_review.evidence: Direct read-only review of production source and fixture, reported by messages to root; no separate review file exists.
reviewed_semantics: Each slot has an independent deferred callback reading its current member; shared resources retain remaining slot callbacks.
Original valid-resource to RID / null-resource to Variant NIL behavior is retained.
Point-valid flag retains resource-reference validity semantics.
Color setter retains shader-change queuing; resource-changed callback does not queue a variant change because the key depends on reference validity.
Object destruction disconnects incoming signals; dead-target queued callbacks are skipped.
static_review.qualification: Shader variant behavior and exact NIL semantics are source-review findings, not dynamically measured oracles in this fixture.

normalization.rule: Capture preserves RID values; every non-RID value, including Variant NIL, is normalized to RID() before comparison.
normalization.limit: Detached/null-RID comparisons do not independently assert the raw Variant type. Populated comparisons still require the exact current nonzero RID.

parse_attempt.issue: First draft inferred weakref() as Variant; warnings-as-errors caused parse failure.
